semiconductor_relevance: High — KOKUSAI ELECTRIC KOREA provides critical semiconductor manufacturing equipment for film deposition and treatment processes.
summary: KOKUSAI ELECTRIC KOREA specializes in semiconductor manufacturing equipment, focusing on film deposition and treatment processes. They offer advanced solutions for Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD), low-pressure chemical vapor deposition (LPCVD), and rapid thermal processing (RTP), supporting high-volume manufacturing and post-anneal applications.
capabilities: Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) for Al2O3, Si3N4, HfO2

regional_presence.Korea: KOKUSAI ELECTRIC KOREA operates in Korea, focusing on semiconductor manufacturing equipment and services.
